name: Pokémon: Advanced Adventure
storyline: In Advanced Adventure, Gary Oak is a tyrannical overlord and you must stop him by defeating his 8 subordinates, genetically modified Pokemon called tyrant Pokémon. You can play as either Ash Ketchum or Misty.
